question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the permanent generic public plugin-SDK contract for cross-plugin tool-progress handling?
rationale: The generic seam is plausible and is used by two bundled plugins, but public plugin-SDK additions are compatibility-sensitive and the available discussion does not contain explicit maintainer approval of this permanent API shape.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the additive kind and predicate, add focused contract coverage, and fix the native-block propagation gap before merge.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Replace the public exports with a narrow internal or runtime seam and migrate both bundled plugins before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive kind and predicate, add focused contract coverage, and fix the native-block propagation gap before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history introduced the adjacent progress contract and rewrote the Slack delivery surface affected by this decision.
